items.text: ...I ummm, I have an unibrow.
This kamikaze is the equivalent fo two airplanes crashing onto each other intentionally.

I would never accept inmortality in the first place. When the universe ends, you would only feel pain. You would feel yourself burning, being constantly sucked into a blackhole, or almost desintegrated by the explosion of a star. But you would surive all of those, since you cant die.

"Gay people are a joke"  
That would be enough to start a nuclear war.
How am I supposed to answer to this?

Scientists: We discovered a  new animal. It can fly an-

Kid: Its a topatusowa!  
Scientist: Who made this petition and how did it pass?
It wont murder your, or suck you in. It will only cuddle with you at nights.
So... You dont admit it...?
That minifig head will see so many things. Make sure he comes back to his body so he can tell others what things he has seen.
Why is it that with so many pieces I cant make a cool ship, while these people can make frog suit armour with around 20 bricks or so.
I do, not because I want. But because I cant turn my ears off.
ww3 starts, a single man kills the entire enemy army and wins the war practically by himself.
It looks cool, but the colors seem stale-ish.
This legitimately looks like its going to eat me.
Nah fam, this is a part of the LEGO USA army.
25 hours? It took me like a week to make a simple house! SMH
I imagined Hitler, Mussolini, Stalin and Lenin. Im pretty sure at least one of them would have wished to have a unicorn pet, if I had truly imagined them.
Can we talk about the fact that a rock almost killed all of them?

Humble? Youcan easily assign them squads  
1) White trooper squads.

2) Gray/black trooper squads.

3) Half helmet (not fully covering the face) trooper squad.  


Go, take over the world!
Stop making it look easy, you are making me cry. ;-;

Lay it down on the floor (calmly) and then scream:  
EVERYONE FLOOPING RUN.

Then of course, I flooping run.
Murdered by a cow riding a horse with a lasso.
Close the doors, get to the kitchen, grab as many nives as I can, barricade everything. Call the co- nevermind that one.
Oh, im not falling for it again!

Heck no, I call my mom/best friend.

Looks very nice, you should try making something bigger!
But... Im not...
